inline_payload_limit.remediation: Inline fields are accepted up to the governed threshold. Larger inline fields are refused with mcp_payload_create plus payload_ref remediation. For one governed submit_work call, pass auto_materialize_payload:true; the result must include payload_source.kind=auto_materialized_payload.

one_call_fallback.audit_contract: Creates an immutable transient payload artifact and reports it in payload_source.

task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool.payload_route: payload_ref is resolved by the parent and merged into arguments before spawning the fresh child.
task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool.top_level_wins: Fields in arguments override payload fields, including task_number and agent_id.

task_lifecycle_review.authority_model: Migrates legacy review calls into review-contract dependency work and task_outcomes authority. New review work should finish the dependency task with task_lifecycle_finish.

inline_payload_limit.remediation: Inline recovery_truthfulness and other companion fields are accepted up to the governed threshold. Put larger summary, findings, outcome evidence, or guard packets in mcp_payload_create, then call task_lifecycle_finish with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id.

payload_ref_shape.reviewer: <optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias>

inline_payload_limit.remediation: Put closeout summaries above the governed inline threshold and optional changed_files/no_files_changed/reviewer in mcp_payload_create, then call task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id.

task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout.review_routing: The optional reviewer is routed through a review-contract dependency; when omitted, the first reviewer-capable roster agent is selected.

inline_payload_limit.remediation: Put next_action and blocker details above the governed inline threshold in mcp_payload_create, then call task_lifecycle_report_blocked with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id. Keep reason concise inline or in the payload.

payload_ref_shape.title: <required task title>
payload_ref_shape.required_work: <markdown string or string[] normalized to newline markdown>
payload_ref_shape.non_goals: <markdown string or string[] normalized to newline markdown>
payload_ref_shape.idempotency_key: <stable retry key; omitted values derive from payload_ref>

execution_binding.workspace_root: <absolute workspace root; defaults to this Site root>
execution_binding.repository_root: <absolute repository root when the task executes repository work>
execution_binding.site_root: <absolute destination Site root; defaults to this task-lifecycle surface Site>
execution_binding.correlation_key: <stable result correlation key; defaults to idempotency_key>

normalized_fields.required_work: string[] joins with newline after trimming empty entries
normalized_fields.non_goals: string[] joins with newline after trimming empty entries

task_lifecycle_admit_evidence.note: Evidence content is read from the task lifecycle store; payload_ref is only for long self_certification guard metadata.

remediation: Use mcp_payload_create with one of these payload shapes, then retry the lifecycle tool with payload_ref plus required top-level identity/routing fields.
